changelog:
• Top-Level Navigation Architecture: Dedicated full-screen Trading History section with [ 🏠 Home ] and [ 📜 Trading History ] segmented navigation tabs in the main HUD
• Real-Time Order & Fill Analytics: Key metric cards for Total Orders, Executed Trades, Traded Lots, and Total Fees Paid
• Multi-Stage Filter & Search: Live filter by Order State, Coin/Symbol, Time Period, and instant text search across all trade fields
• Interactive Chart Switching: Double-clicking any trade or clicking View Chart immediately selects the coin and navigates to the TradingView chart
• 1-Click CSV Export: Export complete trading history with all execution details to CSV
• Over-The-Air Update Engine: Archive execution redirection, permanent desktop shortcuts, and fail-safe relaunch
